package.description: Electron desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

en-US.description: Electron desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
en-US.longDescription: DSH-Desktop is an Electron desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It bundles node and pnpm, installs the official @deepseek-ai/dsh package into ~/.dsh/runtime on first launch, and serves the dsh web UI in a browser window, with plugin and DSH update support.
en-US.name: DSH-Decktop

zh-CN.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Electron 桌面外壳。
zh-CN.longDescription: DSH-Desktop 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Electron 桌面外壳。它内置 node 与 pnpm，首次启动时将官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh 包安装到 ~/.dsh/runtime，并在浏览器窗口中提供 dsh web 界面，支持插件与 DSH 更新。
